about_the_game:
Experience the heartfelt and intimate Original Soundtrack of The Falling Star, composed by Jinyi Shang (Suncall).

Built around the delicate interplay of piano and cello, the music embraces a simple yet powerful acoustic style. Each track carries a sense of warmth and quiet reflection, underscored by a gentle sorrow that echoes the game’s narrative themes of memory, love, and loss.

The soundtrack includes four tracks, provided in both MP3 and uncompressed WAV formats.
